program.section_heading: Exercise, Sport & Wellness - Fitness Professions - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS595/AS595C/CE595
outcomes: Demonstrate an acceptable level of health-related fitness.
Demonstrate appropriate knowledge of fitness testing and of issues specific to different populations.
Identify physiological principles of human movement in exercise and sport settings.
Identify, explain, and apply appropriate principles of physical activity and nutrition for physical well-being and life-long learning.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the A.S. degree and Certificate of Achievement (AS595/AS595C/CE595); the requirements and the Program Learning Outcomes are shared by both awards and recorded here for the A.S. Degree.
The section heading is printed three times with slight variations (AS595/AS595C/CE595 and AS595/AS595B/AS595C/CE595); the first is used.
The description paragraph refers to 'the Exercise, Sport, and Wellness Certificate' although this record is for the A.S. degree.
Elective block does not state how many courses to pick; its printed 3-4 unit range implies choosing one course, recorded as choose_units with minimum 3.
KIN-44A (Yoga Instructor Fundamentals) differs from closed-list KIN 44 (Yoga Instructor Training); recorded as a catalog addition. Reviewer should check whether they are the same course renumbered.
KIN-10, KIN-14 and KIN-16 are not on the closed list and are recorded as catalog additions.
Several courses are marked '( Historical )' (KIN-4, KIN-14, KIN-16, KIN-35, KIN-45), which may indicate inactive courses for the 2026-2027 catalog year.
The degree text names general education and graduation requirements but no specific GE pattern.
